answer.rationale: Rollback is unavailable: compliance forbids reverting the security patch (b1 is therefore not actionable). Circuit breaking (b4) fails requests and would drop customer writes, which violates the objective. The live signature is write-path p99 at daily settlement peak with heavy writes; b3 is the closest prior: headroom absorbed a surge and kept queues flat. b5 recovered write latency only when report reads were removed from the primary, which is not established here; regional failover (b2) assumes a regional fault that is not indicated, and a traffic shift during peak settlement risks in-flight writes. Intend add_capacity as the intervention that can relieve write saturation without discarding writes. Uncertainty remains: latency rise is also coincident with the release and may be patch-induced work per write rather than lack of headroom; verifying b3 before commit checks whether that lesson was pre-peak provisioning only.
